description: Install a single Workbench component by id (e.g. `node`, `opencode`, `npm-mcps`, `skills`) on a target; `component` must be an id from describe_workbench. Overwrites that component's files when present (e.g. `skills`/`plugins` replace the copies under `<home>/.config/opencode`); global installs need write permission and can take minutes. Idempotent and consent-gated: without `confirm:true` it returns the plan. Parameter semantics: `component` is required; `workspace` defaults to `~/opencode-workbench`; `confirm` defaults to false (plan only). Use it for one targeted component; use apply_clone to install the full default set.

confirm.description: Set true to actually install. When absent, the call returns a plan and makes no changes.

target.description: The machine to operate on: this host (local) or a remote host over SSH (ssh).

mode.description: Run on this machine (local) or a remote host (ssh).

user.description: SSH user (defaults to ssh config / current user).

workspace.description: Target directory for the profile repo.

name: install_component

degraded.description: Capabilities disabled because required credentials are absent; fill the named env vars to enable them.

dryRun.description: True when the run made no changes.

envVars.description: Environment variable names listed in the env template.

installed.description: Components installed, with exit codes and output.

code.description: Exit code of the install step.

model.description: Default model selected for the target (DeepSeek when its key is present, else the OpenCode Zen free floor).

toInstall.description: Component ids that would be installed.

providerMode.description: Which provider the model resolves to.

requiresConfirmation.description: True when the call returned a plan without applying; re-call with confirm:true to install.

skipped.description: Component ids skipped (already present or manual).

workspace.description: Directory where the profile repo was cloned.

title: Install one Workbench component
